name: tokenomics
description: Make every AI token earn its keep: not just cheaper AI, better value from AI. spendlens tags sessions OPEX (run) or CAPEX (build); pennywise routes each prompt to the right model (cheaper for simple, stronger for hard), as a hook or a local routing proxy; diet stops context-flooding tool calls; budget sets daily and per-session limits in pounds; doggybag packs a cheap resume note into the project before the cache goes cold; coach and spend-report skills review your prompts and spend; bangforbuck measures cost per outcome; haggle quotes a task and holds it to an agreed price; sherlock finds wasted agent steps; waistline catches cost regressions (also in CI); tastetest proves a saving kept quality; springclean audits instruction files; groundhog breaks agent loops; splitthebill attributes spend by project, developer, agent, model and provider; bazaar finds the best-value provider; blinkers stops scope creep; crystalball simulates spend before adoption; deadwood reports spend on work that produced nothing; packlight measures the fixed load every request carries and the MCP servers and skills you never use; ballast warns when a new task drags the last one's context along; waffle costs long replies, recaps and whole-file rewrites; coldsnap finds every prompt-cache rebuild and its cause; parrot turns the instructions you keep repeating into CLAUDE.md lines and slash commands; allyoucaneat checks whether pay-as-you-go, Pro or Max fits your spend; a live cost and cache statusline (/tokenomics:statusline) and dashboard (/tokenomics:dashboard).
